{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sacred Tokens of the Legendary Ewok Warriors''' were artifacts given to the [[Caravan of Courage (group)|Caravan of Courage]] by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] to help them on their quest to rescue [[Catarine Towani|Catarine]] and [[Jeremitt Towani]] from a [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]]. [[Deej]], the leader of the group was given the [[White Wings of Hope]], [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]] was given the [[Red Wings of Courage]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] was given a magic walking stick, [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]] was given the [[Blue Wings of Strength]], [[Cindel Towani]] was given the [[Candle of Pure Light]], and [[Mace Towani]] was given a [[Magic rock|rock]]. A [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and an [[Ivory Tooth|ivory tooth]] were brought along to give to other Ewoks who they needed to find to join them in their quest.<ref name="CoC">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>

The ivory tooth was given to [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]], who joins the group after an axe throwing contest with Mace. The crystal was given the priestess [[Kaink/Legends|Kaink]], she joined only after the group had completed a test. During the test the crystal was turned into a lizard, and then a white mouse. Mace ended up being trapped beneath the surface of a [[Endor magic lake|lake]], and Wicket needed to use his magic stick to pull him to safety. Mace's rock was used to open the entrance to [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax]].<ref name="CoC" />
